Answer: C
Reason: The frontal chest X-ray (Figure 1a) clearly displays two distinct nodular opacities indicated by blue arrows: one in the right mid-lung zone silhouetting the right heart border (consistent with right middle lobe location) and another retrocardiac opacity on the left. This specific finding of discrete nodules rules out diffuse patterns like metastases or sarcoidosis, and aligns with the description in option C regarding DIPNECH (Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia), which often presents with such nodules and mosaic attenuation.
